# v0.11.0 beta - C++ renderer

This beta improves automatic frame pacing, palette transitions, fog, enhanced
imaging, and installation guidance, and adds live mission view-distance tuning.

## Highlights

- Added a single `launchMW2.bat` launcher that automatically selects the frame cadence based on your monitor's refresh rate.
- Smoothed mission fade-ins and time-of-day palette transitions with full-precision interpolation.
- Fixed textured objects receiving no fog in levels with dense fog.
- Fixed missing terrain in enhanced imaging.
- Added a level tweaker with live preview for adjusting and saving view distance. Included corrected view distances for Aquiline Fire (`aquascn1`) and the trial missions `goudscn1` and `colbscn1`.
- Added full fractional scaling support and improved CRT effects for the damage wireframe display.
- Increased the shipped HUD defaults for larger panels, text, and targeting markers: `panel_scaling` and `font_scaling` changed from `0.6` to `1.0`, and `target_marker_scaling` changed from `0.0` to `0.5`. The targeting-marker setting controls the center reticle, NAV circle, and offscreen target arrows.
- Restored the AUTOPILOT HUD label, including its original visibility and positioning rules.
- Made scene and empty target/MFD backgrounds follow live palette effects.
- Improved texture and palette readiness, including LUMA fallback, so missing resources no longer stop frame progress.
- Shared scene uniforms across rendering passes and reused retained terrain geometry for enhanced imaging.
- Added temporary quarter-speed, normal, and eight-speed simulation controls to the level tweaker.
- Added an optional frame-cadence overlay. Enable **Frame cadence graph** in the configurator's **HUD** section, or set `frame_cadence = true` under `[HUD]` in `mw2mods/mod.conf`.
- Combined installation instructions and file checks in the configurator, with CD-image presence checks, supported executable version detection, and patch guidance when needed.

The bundled DOSBox-X host is **v0.3.2 beta**. It keeps native scene rendering
suppressed while the enhanced renderer owns the scene and prevents native output
from appearing during temporary frame unavailability in enhanced-only view.
It also adds automatic display-compatible frame rates and independent
presentation of ready enhanced frames.

Renderer and FreeType source accompany this release. Matching host source is
available from [the DOSBox-X v0.3.2 source snapshot](https://github.com/furious-pixel/dosbox-x-mod/archive/refs/tags/v0.3.2.zip).

## Installation and upgrade

**Supported platform:** Windows x64 on Intel or AMD 64-bit hardware. You need
your own DOS MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat installation, patched to v1.1,
and its CD image.

For a first installation, extract the release into a fresh directory and run
`configure.bat`. Follow both installation steps, including copying the complete
installed game directory. If you had to rename the .bin / .cue files, edit the
filename in the first line of the .cue file to reference `MECH2_16B.bin`, keeping
the rest of that line unchanged.

For an upgrade, extract into a fresh directory and copy these from your previous
installation:

- `game/`
- `mw2mods/mod.conf`
- `mw2mods/joystick.conf`, if present
- `mw2mods/user_level_overrides.json`, if present

Copying your previous `mod.conf` preserves your existing scaling settings. To use
the new larger defaults, set `panel_scaling = 1.0`, `font_scaling = 1.0`, and
`target_marker_scaling = 0.5` under `[HUD]`, or adjust those options in the
configurator.

See [the README](https://github.com/furious-pixel/mw2-enhanced-renderer-mod#readme) for configuration, level-tweaker controls,
credits, and known limitations.
